verdicts.observation: Evidence: frozen snippet tome-cults/data/talents/demented/tentacles.lua L72-79 (source unpinned). (1) Source L73 says the tentacles hit 'your target and those on the side', meaning the creatures flanking the target. The translation '目标同侧的其他单位' reads as 'units on the same side as the target', which misstates who gets hit; it should say something like '目标两侧的单位'. I could not check the exact hit pattern because the envelope does not give a cults checkout location, so this part is a text-based judgement. (2) Source L77 is a blank line before 'Your tentacle hand currently has these stats%s:', but the target drops it. That breaks the newline/line-structure invariant. (3) Minor: the source puts 'civilized people' in quotes, and that irony is lost in '普通人'.
